title: WP-031 - configuration and isolation execution record

sections.heading: Configuration entries
sections.text: At 12:52 backup rolls were removed. At 12:57 the balance was raised. At 13:00 electrical isolation was recorded complete and the V17 handle was recorded CLOSED. These entries establish reported execution, not valve tightness.

sections.heading: Restraint observation
sections.text: A configuration photograph taken at 13:00 and reviewed against the block locations shows no independent positive block under YK-3. The carrier is in contact with the mill post/spreader. The photo does not resolve keeper overlap.

sections.heading: Verification coverage
sections.text: No loaded hold test, chamber-volume test or keeper-envelope check was recorded before work began. The absence of these entries does not prove deliberate noncompliance or explain the origin of any component defect.
